title: Lumen Glass
summary: A harbor glassworks is selling shares. The works pays no dividend this season.

title: North Pier Storage
summary: Lockers beside the ferry ramp. Each share pays a dollar a month.

title: Brine and Barrel
summary: A pickling house on the cannery road. Two dollars a month comes back on each share.

title: Paper Kite Press
summary: A small press that prints tide tables. The shares are cheap and pay nothing yet.

title: Cedar Lane Studio
summary: A one-room rental over a cabinet shop. Twenty dollars a month is left after the note.

title: Dockside Room
summary: A furnished room above the chandlery. The net rent is forty dollars a month.

title: Maple Court Cottage
summary: A tired cottage that still needs a new roof. The note costs ten dollars more than the rent.

title: Orchard Gate Shed
summary: A shed at the orchard gate, bought with cash and no note. It clears twenty-five dollars a month.
